description: This file contains unit tests for 'network-errors.ts', focusing on error handling functions related to Telegram network errors, including detection of recoverable errors, rate limits, server errors, client rejections, and error origin tagging. It uses the Vitest testing framework to verify behavior of various functions under different error scenarios.

classes.name: MockHttpError
classes.description: A mock error class simulating an HTTP error wrapping other errors, used for testing error detection functions.

methods.name: errorWithCode
methods.description: Creates an Error object with an attached 'code' property.

methods.name: errorWithTelegramCode
methods.description: Creates an Error object with an attached 'error_code' property.
